latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Solana price alert system.

- Users can create, view, and delete token price alerts with confirmation prompts.
- Supports "above" or "below" alert conditions for any token.
- Guardrails include a 20 alert maximum and sanity checks for unusual target prices.
- Includes scripts for alert creation, listing, deletion, and manual price checking.
